post.description: Run a model on its input. Short jobs answer 201 with the finished job; long ones answer 202 with a job id: follow it with GET /v1/jobs/{jobId}, its events, Prefer: wait=60 or a webhookUrl. The made files land in your Summer library. No rate limits on paid usage: past your running slots a job answers 202 queued at a held price and starts in order.

post.description: No rate limits on paid usage. Every job is priced first: when your paid credits and the app's own limit cover them all, all are accepted (202) and run in order as your running slots free up (10 at once, up to 40 as you buy more credits). If they do not fit, nothing is accepted: 402 says how many fit and how much more is needed. Optional Idempotency-Key for the whole batch; each job may carry its own idempotencyKey.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: One key for the whole batch: a retry with the same key answers the batch it made and never queues it twice.

202.description: Accepted: every job queued, each at the price it holds (no quoteId: each job is priced when the batch is accepted).

id.description: q:<id> until it starts; reads answer the job it became.

counts.description: How many jobs are in each state.

items.description: Each job as GET /v1/jobs/{jobId} answers it: id, state, model, estimatedPrice, price once known, result once done.
